description: 12-in-1 Docking Station and Monitor Stand: Equip your workstation with a 100W max USB-C upstream port (connect to laptop), 3 USB-A ports, 2 USB-C ports, SD/microSD card slots, a 4K HDMI port, a wireless charging pad, and an Ethernet port. All-in-One Workspace Organizer: Stand your monitor on top of the docking station, and use the space underneath to store your keyboard, mouse, and other peripherals when you're not using them. User-Friendly Design: By raising your monitor off the desk, you'll be able to sit up straight instead of slouching—promoting a healthier posture and a more comfortable work experience. Power Your Entire Workstation: With a 100W max USB-C upstream port to charge your laptop, 2 USB-C Power Delivery ports sharing 45W, 3 USB-A ports for smaller devices, and a wireless charging pad for your phone, you have more than enough options to keep your whole workspace powered up. What You Get: Anker 675 USB-C Docking Station (12-in-1, Monitor Stand, Wireless), welcome guide, our worry-free 18-month warranty, and friendly customer service.

Organize Your Workspace with Upgraded Comfort and Connectivity
 
Expand Your Capabilities
Just connect your laptop to unlock high-speed charging, fast file transfer, 4K display, and more.
 
Work in Comfort
Thanks to the built-in stand, you can now keep your monitor at eye level so you won't have to slouch or strain your neck while you work.
 
Power All Your Devices
Supports 100W max charging for your laptop, wireless charging for your phone, and fast USB-C charging for all your other workspace devices.
 
Keep Cables Out of the Way
A built-in cable management system on the underside of the monitor stand lets you keep cables tidy—and out of your way.

Excellent and smart product

More than happy with my Anker 675 USB-C Docking station, seamless switching between MacBook, Dell laptops and HP laptop by just one cable. Future request - support for multiple screens.

V
V.K.
Even Better than expected

For my work laptop I have an expensive "professional" docking station at the office. It can only support 2k 60hz SDR. What I didn't expect is that the Anker 675 immediately without any fiddling from my side enabled 2k 100Hz HDR. Wireless charging also worked on all of my devices. All in all - great experience and well worth it.

G
G.B.
USB C cable

Oh, where do I even begin with this stunning piece of technology that set me back a mere 250 euros? Clearly, the manufacturer believes in the philosophy of minimalism, especially when it comes to the USB-C cable length. A whole meter of cable? How generous! So thoughtful!

For 250 euros, you’d think they could spring for an extra bit of cord, but no, why spoil us with luxury? It’s a refreshing change from those extravagant, longer cables that just create a mess of options and flexibility. Who needs all that freedom anyway?

Apart from this delightful cable situation, the device itself is...fine, I guess. It works as expected, which is probably the overall experience: sturdy, light, and looks nice!
